name: kitegtm
description: Ask about your KiteGTM missions, buyer fits, conversations, campaigns and qualified opportunities across email, LinkedIn and SMS, and act on them from Codex and ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: KiteGTM finds the companies and decision-makers that match what you sell, works them over email, LinkedIn and SMS, and hands you qualified opportunities. This plugin lets you ask about that work and act on it: see which missions need attention, read conversations and draft replies, review buyer fits and opportunities, check campaigns, import contacts and add them to campaigns, pause or resume a mission or campaign, and record what came of an opportunity. Replies are saved as drafts that you send from KiteGTM. Billing and payments stay in KiteGTM.
capabilities: Read missions, buyer fits, conversations, campaigns and opportunities
Draft a reply that you send from KiteGTM
Pause, resume or stop a mission, a campaign or a person
Import contacts and add them to a campaign
defaultPrompt: Which of my KiteGTM missions need attention?
Show me this week's qualified opportunities
Who replied today, and which replies need me?
